auth.portalHeadline: Your group’s investing journey, clearly in view.
auth.portalDescription: Keep monthly challenges, investor contributions, and reports together in one trusted workspace.
auth.secureWorkspace: A secure space for your investment group
auth.adminAccess: Private access for your admin team
auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to continue to your investment group workspace.

dashboard.challengeProgress: Verified contributions and challenge activity at a glance.
dashboard.createChallengeHint: Create a monthly challenge to start tracking contributions.

pages.challenges: Create monthly rounds, open and close them, and lock edits when a round is closed.
pages.transactions: Fast mobile entry with proof upload, duplicate detection, verification and audit log.
pages.investors: Manage investor names, phone numbers, notes and status, with bulk import.
pages.reports: Challenge summary in the Excel layout, statements, comparisons and Excel/PDF exports.
pages.import: Upload the existing Excel sheet, map investors and reconcile totals before importing.
